provenance_policy: Only explicit source-supported actor/campaign facts are asserted. Null, empty arrays, and not_stated fields are valid outcomes; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.

actors.name: APT29

attribution.rationale: MITRE ATT&CK describes APT29 as attributed to Russia's SVR and references public US/UK attribution of the SolarWinds compromise to the SVR. This is a sourced public attribution, not independent confirmation by this dashboard.

motivation.rationale: The profile documents targeting of government networks, research institutes and think tanks; espionage is an analytic characterization of that targeting, not a directly quoted motive statement.

actors.recent_activity: No recent operational activity date is asserted in this profile. MITRE's profile modification date is 2026-07-31 and must not be interpreted as last-seen activity.
actors.confidence_rationale: Group identity, aliases, attribution statement, target categories and technique mappings are documented on the MITRE ATT&CK group page. Individual alias equivalence and campaign links inherit MITRE's source-level confidence; this dashboard does not independently validate them.

campaigns.name: Operation Ghost
campaigns.summary: MITRE ATT&CK lists Operation Ghost as a campaign associated with APT29, with activity dated September 2013 through October 2019. The campaign entry describes use of domains, steganography, malware, social-media accounts and Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) event subscriptions. The source does not provide a campaign-specific CVE or IOC list in this record.
campaigns.objectives: Not specified in the campaign-specific MITRE entry; do not infer from actor-level targeting.

detection_opportunities.suggestion: Monitor creation and modification of WMI event filters, consumers and filter-to-consumer bindings; baseline legitimate subscriptions.
detection_opportunities.validation: Defensive recommendation derived from the mapped ATT&CK technique; no campaign-specific detection rule is linked.

detection_opportunities.suggestion: Monitor newly registered or newly observed domains associated with infrastructure used by relevant services; require enrichment and reputation checks before blocking.
detection_opportunities.validation: Defensive recommendation derived from the mapped ATT&CK technique; no campaign-specific IOC list is supplied.

detection_opportunities.suggestion: Investigate unusual image-file transfers or steganography indicators only where endpoint/network telemetry supports content inspection.
detection_opportunities.validation: Hunt hypothesis derived from the mapped ATT&CK technique; not a confirmed indicator.
